arguments.content:
import zipfile, shutil

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    data = {n: z.read(n) for n in names}

sheet = data['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
styles = data['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')

# 1. Extend dimension
old_dim = 'ref="A1:G10"'
new_dim = 'ref="A1:H10"'
assert old_dim in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old_dim, new_dim, 1)

# 2. Add column definition for H
old_cols = '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/></cols>'
new_cols = '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>'
assert old_cols in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old_cols, new_cols, 1)

# 3. Header H1
old_h1 = '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>'
new_h1 = '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c><c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>'
assert old_h1 in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old_h1, new_h1, 1)

# 4. Data rows 2..9: H = G / E with percentage style (s=3)
for r in range(2, 10):
    old_cell = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    new_cell = f'{old_cell}<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    assert old_cell in sheet, f"missing G{r}"
    sheet = sheet.replace(old_cell, new_cell, 1)

# 5. TOTAL row H10: overall margin = G10/E10, bold + percent (s=4)
old_tot = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>'
new_tot = f'{old_tot}<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c>'
assert old_tot in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old_tot, new_tot, 1)

# 6. Styles: add percentage formats (numFmtId 10 = 0.00%)
old_count = '<cellXfs count="3">'
new_count = '<cellXfs count="5">'
assert old_count in styles
styles = styles.replace(old_count, new_count, 1)

old_xfs = '<xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>'
new_xfs = ('<xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
           '<xf numFmtId="10" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" applyNumberFormat="1" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
           '<xf numFmtId="10" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" applyNumberFormat="1" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>')
assert old_xfs in styles
styles = styles.replace(old_xfs, new_xfs, 1)

data['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')
data['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for n in names:
        z.writestr(n, data[n])

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print("done")
